title: Tower Pack
description: This datapack adds a new tower to Minecraft. It is mildly rare and spawns in plains biomes.
body:
This Minecraft Data Pack adds a cool new tower to the game. It has fully furnished interior, making it a good starter base. It is also mildly rare, balancing the rarity so it's not too rare, and not too common.
